waypoint.name: Name
waypoints.title: Waypoints
waypoints.empty: No waypoints yet – press {0} in game to create one.
chat.hotkeyTooFast: Text hotkey: too many in a row
module.keystrokes.desc: WASD, mouse buttons and space bar
module.ping.desc: Latency to the server (not in singleplayer)
module.server.desc: Address of the current server (not in singleplayer)
module.packs.desc: List of the enabled resource packs
module.toggleSprint.desc: Press the sprint key once to keep sprinting, press it again to stop. The HUD shows the state, e.g. [Sprinting (Toggled)]. Optional fly boost in creative mode.
module.toggleSneak.desc: Press the sneak key once to keep sneaking, press it again to stop. The HUD shows the state, e.g. [Sneaking (Toggled)].
module.reach.desc: Distance of your last hit (display only – your reach itself stays unchanged)
module.combo.desc: Counts hits in a row; ends when you get hit yourself or stop hitting for a moment
module.minimap.desc: Small map of your surroundings (block colors from above) with waypoints. Shows loaded chunks only – no X-ray, no cave view.
module.crosshair.desc: Your own crosshair: shape, color, size and gap are freely adjustable
module.hitColor.desc: Color that mobs and players briefly flash in when hit
module.freelook.desc: Hold the key to orbit the camera around your character; you keep walking and looking straight ahead and the server only ever sees your real view direction. Some servers forbid freelook – respect the server rules. On servers in the list it switches itself off.
module.zoom.desc: Hold the key to zoom in smoothly. The mouse wheel changes the zoom while held and the mouse slows down with it. Pauses while you look through a spyglass.
module.titleScreen.desc: TRS title screen instead of the vanilla one
module.oldAnimations.desc: Old hand movements: the hand does not dip during the attack cooldown, swing animation also while using an item (visual only)
module.lowFire.desc: Pulls the flames at the edge of the screen down while you are burning
module.blockOutline.desc: Color and width of the outline around the block you are looking at
module.hitboxes.desc: Shows the hitboxes of mobs like F3+B (display only – the boxes themselves do not change)
module.noHurtCam.desc: The camera no longer tilts when you take damage
module.chat.desc: Timestamps, stacking of identical messages and copying with Ctrl+click
module.autoGg.desc: Automatically sends a message when a game ends. Off by default; at most once per minute. Some servers do not like it – only use it where it is allowed.
module.textHotkeys.desc: Four freely bindable keys each send a fixed text or command. Off by default, at most one message per second.
module.waypoints.desc: Your own markers per world/server: press the key, pick a name and color; shown in game with distance and light beam, plus a death point.
module.trsOnline.desc: TRS badges and TRS capes of other players, your own cape and your online status for friends. Signs in with your Minecraft account, just like joining a server. Only shows that someone uses TRS.
module.capePhysics.desc: Capes (Mojang, OptiFine, TRS) move like cloth: they swing when you walk, turn, jump and sneak. Style, wind, movement and gravity are adjustable, with a live preview of your own player (drag it to turn).
module.colors.desc: Color grading of the game image: saturation, contrast, brightness, vibrance and color temperature. The HUD and menus stay untouched. Pauses while a shader pack is active.
module.emotes.desc: Hold the emote key (G) for the emote wheel, point at an emote with the mouse and release the key to play it. Other TRS players see it too. Needs the TRS Online Features; only unlocked emotes can be played.
wheel.title: Emotes
wheel.lockedToast: This emote is locked – unlock it with a code in the launcher
wheel.hintHold: Point with the mouse · release {0} to play
wheel.offLauncher: TRS online features are switched off in the launcher (Settings → Privacy). Emotes need them.
wheel.offModule: Turn on “TRS Online Features” in the TRS menu to use emotes.
wheel.noAccount: Emotes need a Minecraft account signed in with Microsoft.
wheel.banned: This account cannot use the TRS online features.
wheel.retry: The TRS API cannot be reached right now. Try again in a moment.
module.redstoneSignal.desc: Look at dust, repeaters, comparators, pistons, lamps, levers and more: shows the block, its signal strength (0–15), repeater delay, comparator mode and output, piston state and the comparator output of containers you have opened.
module.redstoneOverlay.desc: Shows the signal strength as a number above every piece of redstone dust around you, from grey (0) to bright red (15). Switch it on and off with its key (controls menu).
module.redstoneClock.desc: Measures how fast the redstone component you look at switches: frequency in Hz, period and pulse length in redstone ticks, plus a small oscilloscope.
setting.redstoneSignal.name: Block name
module.fpsBoost.desc: Main switch of all performance features (off = compare without them). One click sets everything to Low, Medium or High, the performance check finds FPS killers in your video settings, and you see the FPS before and after. Every change can be undone.
module.dynamicFps.desc: Limits the frame rate while the game is in the background, minimized or you are AFK, and makes it quieter. Full FPS the moment you come back.
module.entityCulling.desc: Skips drawing mobs, chests, signs, dropped items and item frames that are hidden behind walls or further away than you set. Display only – nothing changes in the world. Hiding behind walls rests while a shader pack is active (shadows need every entity).
module.particles.desc: Fewer particles: an upper limit, a share of all particles and single kinds switched off (explosions, rain splashes, smoke).
module.worldDetails.desc: Switch off details that cost frames: sky, stars, fog, rain and snow, animated textures (water, lava, fire). Only what works cleanly in this version.
module.builtinOptimizations.desc: Free performance mods built into the TRS Client (Lithium, FerriteCore, ImmediatelyFast, ModernFix, BadOptimizations – where available for this version). Your own newer versions take priority. Switching off takes effect at the next start through the TRS Launcher.
setting.entityCulling.players: Always show players at any distance
perf.master.off: FPS Boost is off – all performance features are paused. Switch it on at the top right.
perf.master.offShort: Paused: the main switch FPS Boost is off.
perf.fps.none: Pick a level or fix something below – the FPS before and after appear here.
perf.boost.title: Level
perf.boost.hint: Low changes little, High gives the most FPS with less detail. Video settings are only ever lowered and the frame limit is lifted; Undo restores everything, even after a restart.
perf.mode.title: Graphics
perf.mode.hint.pretty: Pretty: only performance switches that look the same – nothing visible changes.
perf.mode.hint.max: Max FPS: clouds off, fewer particles, smooth lighting off, fast graphics and fast leaves. Your own changes stay; performance mods follow at the next start.
perf.check.title: Performance check
perf.check.unavailable: The check is available once the game has fully loaded.
perf.check.gpu: Minecraft runs on the onboard graphics ({0}) although a graphics card ({1}) is installed. The TRS Launcher can switch that for you.
perf.check.vsync: VSync is on: it caps the FPS at the monitor rate and adds input lag.
perf.check.fpsLimit: Frame limit {0} FPS: the game never renders faster, however strong your PC is. Set it to "Unlimited".
perf.check.simulation: Simulation distance {0} is not below the render distance {1} – that costs CPU. Suggested: {2}.
perf.check.view: Render distance {0} is high for {1} FPS. Suggested: {2}.
perf.check.fabulous: Graphics "Fabulous" is very expensive – "Fast" gives the most FPS.
perf.check.fullscreen: Tip: fullscreen (F11) is often faster than a window.
perf.check.mods: Not installed: {0}. The TRS Launcher can add them with the "FPS Boost" preset (where available for this version).
perf.mods.title: Performance mods
perf.bundled.restart: Takes effect at the next start through the TRS Launcher.
module.clips.desc: Save the last seconds as a clip (F9) or start and stop a recording (F10). The TRS Launcher records the game window – nothing leaves your PC. Turn it on in the launcher under Settings → Clips.
clips.hint.noLauncher: Clips only work when the game is started from the TRS Launcher
clips.hint.disabled: Clips are off – turn them on in the TRS Launcher (Settings → Clips)
clips.hint.unreachable: The TRS Launcher is not reachable – is it still running?
clips.failed.starting: Recording is still starting – try again in a moment
clips.failed.noWindow: Game window not found – nothing was recorded
clips.failed.ffmpeg: The launcher is still downloading the recorder (FFmpeg)
clips.failed.noFrames: Nothing recorded yet – try again in a few seconds
clips.failed.error: The clip could not be saved – see the TRS Launcher
